_meta.description: LogUnify logs: hot 0-7d, warm 7-30d, cold 30-180d, delete at 180d only after a snapshot exists. Works on a Basic license.
_meta.regulation: CERT-In Directions No. 20(3)/2022-CERT-In (28 Apr 2022): keep ICT logs for a rolling 180 days, within Indian jurisdiction
_meta.age_reference: phase min_age counts from ROLLOVER, so every document is at least min_age old when its index is deleted
